newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich December securities turnover rises 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zurich December securities turnover rises 0.5 pct.

text.p: Securities turnover in Switzerland's biggest canton, Zurich, rose 0.5 pct in December from the month before to 51.33 billion Swiss francs, cantonal bourse authorities said.
Turnover was up 12.1 percent from December of 1995.
Cumulative turnover for 1996 was 29.9-percent higher than the year before at 588.7 billion francs.
The figures cover all trade in securities and securities derivatives on and off the bourse and on the Swiss Options and Financial Futures Exchange (Soffex).
